title: ATG Authorization Envelope
description: An ATG action envelope that separates the proposing agent from the authorizing component. Modelled after RFC-0001 (Trusted Authorization Path) — the host may propose an action but may not silently redefine the authority that approves it.

mandate_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the mandate authorizing this action.

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the executable payload.

class.description: Authorization class per RFC-0001. A0: read-only. A1: reversible low-impact. A2: bounded hardware-backed. A3: irreversible, requires isolated signer + human review. A4: root authority, requires quorum + delay.

authorizer.description: The component that exercises authority (signer identifier, HSM key, threshold group).

signer_type.description: Class of signing device or authority.

key_residency.description: Whether the signing secret can be exported from the signing device.

display_trust.description: Display trust classification. 'opaque' MUST NOT satisfy A3 or A4 without explicit emergency override governed by separate policy and quorum.

confirmation.description: How authorization was confirmed by the approving party.

blind_signing.description: True when the payload could not be clearly rendered for review. Must fail closed by default for A3+.

fallback_used.description: Whether a weaker authorization path was used as fallback. Silent downgrade is prohibited per RFC-0001.
